description: Multi-capability BPMN generation request should decompose into ≤3 skills
input: 我想做一个功能：用户描述一段业务流程，系统自动生成标准BPMN图，并优化并行步骤
expected_behavior: Phase 1 produces scope summary. Phase 2 decomposes into ≥3 capabilities. Phase 3 classifies most as tool/workflow_step, ≤2 as skill. Phase 4 self-critique runs Check A and B. Output capability_plan.json with summary.skills ≤ 2.

description: Single-purpose request should pass through to guiding-skill-authoring directly
input: 我要写一个skill，用来查询EV充电桩的故障日志
expected_behavior: Planning step recognizes this is a single, already-scoped capability. Produces a plan with exactly 1 skill. Immediately recommends routing to guiding-skill-authoring.

description: Over-fragmented bundle submission triggers self-critique merge
input: 我上传了8个skill，都是entity extraction相关的：extract-person, extract-org, extract-location, extract-date, extract-money, extract-product, validate-entities, deduplicate-entities
expected_behavior: Self-Critique Check A fires (each ≤1 step). Check B fires (>70% overlap). Output: all reclassified as tool. summary.skills = 0. Anti-pattern Anti-Pattern 1 or 2 cited in findings.

description: Ambiguous requirement that cannot be scoped in one sentence
expected_behavior: Phase 1 Step 1 fires all four clarifying questions. Planning does NOT proceed to Phase 2 until all four are answered. No capability_plan.json is emitted.
